mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Reported_Company mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.P_Id = #{pId} order by mn.Create_Time desc
